# Tertaut — Developer Infrastructure & Merchant of Record Platform Documentation

> Canonical AI & LLM reference documentation for tertaut.com.
> Platform: Merchant of Record (MoR), Ed25519 Cryptographic Licensing, and AI Proxy Shield for software creators.
> Operator: PT RETAS LINTAS BATAS, Kabupaten Sumenep, Jawa Timur, Indonesia.
> Official Website: https://tertaut.com
> Primary Currency: IDR (Indonesian Rupiah)
> Compliance: UU No. 27/2022 (UU PDP), Google API Services User Data Policy, PPN 11% Tax Compliance.

---

## 1. Executive Summary

Tertaut (tertaut.com) is the specialized Merchant of Record (MoR) and developer infrastructure platform engineered for software builders, indie hackers, desktop application developers (Electron, Tauri, Flutter, C#/.NET), and AI tool creators in Indonesia.

Unlike traditional payment gateways that merely process card or e-wallet transactions, Tertaut operates as a full Merchant of Record:
- **Zero Corporate Overhead**: Indonesian software creators can legally sell software without establishing a PT or CV corporation.
- **Tax & Invoicing Handled**: Tertaut calculates, collects, and remits value-added tax (PPN 11%) and issues compliant electronic tax receipts.
- **Automated Payouts**: Creators receive clean net payouts (95% net after Tertaut's flat 5% platform fee) directly into Indonesian bank accounts.
- **Built-in DRM & Licensing**: Complete cryptographic license management system with zero need for third-party DRM servers.

---

## 2. Core Pillars & Architecture

### Pillar 1: Merchant of Record (MoR) Checkout
- **Payment Methods**: Instant dynamic QRIS (QR Code Indonesian Standard), Bank Virtual Accounts (BCA, Mandiri, BRI, BNI, Permata), DANA, Xendit, and SNAP BI.
- **Pricing Model**: Flat 5% platform fee per successful transaction. No monthly subscription, no setup fee, no hidden withdrawal charges.
- **Disbursement**: Automated daily or weekly bank transfer payouts to builders' registered bank accounts via BI-FAST / local clearing.
- **Customer Checkout**: Hosted or embedded seamless checkout with coupon discounts, instant fulfillment webhooks, and invoice downloads.

### Pillar 2: Universal Cryptographic Licensing Engine (@tertaut/sdk)
- **Asymmetric Cryptography**: Powered by Ed25519 digital signatures. Offline tokens are mathematically verified client-side using Tertaut's public key without requiring any secret key inside the user's client app binary.
- **Offline-First Capability**: Once validated, clients receive an Ed25519 signed JWT token granting offline usage for up to 30 days without an internet connection.
- **Hardware ID (HWID) Binding**: Locks licenses to physical devices using SHA-256 salted machine fingerprints (CPU, disk, MAC address) to stop software piracy.
- **Multi-Device Quotas**: Builders configure seat limits (e.g. 1 seat, 3 seats, or unlimited). Devices can be released or transferred atomically.
- **Floating Rolling Seats**: Leases seats with background heartbeats. If a client machine powers down, the seat automatically returns to the pool within 5 minutes.

### Pillar 3: AI API Proxy Shield & Cost Guardrails
- **Credential Protection**: Upstream LLM master API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenRouter) are encrypted with AES-256-GCM in Tertaut's server vaults and never exposed to client applications.
- **License-Gated Access**: Requests to the AI Proxy Shield require a valid, non-expired Tertaut license key or active offline token.
- **Rate Limiting & Token Caps**: Automatic request throttling (15 req/min) and daily token expenditure caps prevent runaway API bills.
- **Streaming Support**: Full Server-Sent Events (SSE) relay for low-latency streaming chat responses.
- **Zero Prompt Retention**: User prompts and LLM completions are passed transiently in memory without persistent storage on Tertaut servers, preserving user privacy.

---

## 3. Official Developer SDK Integration

Official NPM Package: `@tertaut/sdk`
Supports: Node.js, Bun, TypeScript, Browser, Electron, Tauri, React Native.

### Installation
```bash
bun add @tertaut/sdk
# or
npm install @tertaut/sdk
```

### Client-Side License Verification (Offline-Capable)
```typescript
import { TertautClient } from "@tertaut/sdk";

const client = new TertautClient({
  appId: "app_your_app_id",
  publicKey: "MCowBQYDK2VwAyEA...", // Ed25519 Public Key
});

// Activate license and bind device seat
const result = await client.activate({
  licenseKey: "TT-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX",
  deviceName: "MacBook Pro M3",
});

if (result.success) {
  console.log("License is valid until:", result.expiresAt);
  // Offline token can now be cached locally for up to 30 days
}
```

### Server-to-Server (S2S) License Issuance
```typescript
const response = await fetch("https://tertaut.com/api/v1/s2s/licenses/issue", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer tt_secret_your_secret_key",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    appId: "app_your_app_id",
    customerEmail: "user@example.com",
    customerName: "Budi Santoso",
    maxSeats: 3,
    grantDays: 365,
  }),
});
const license = await response.json();
```

---

## 4. Key API Endpoints Reference

| Endpoint | Method | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/api/v1/checkout/session` | POST | Public | Create new checkout transaction |
| `/api/v1/checkout/status/:txId` | GET | Public | Poll real-time payment status |
| `/api/v1/licensing/activate` | POST | Public | Activate license key & bind device seat |
| `/api/v1/licensing/validate` | POST | License Token | Validate existing license or refresh offline token |
| `/api/v1/licensing/heartbeat` | POST | License Token | Send lease heartbeat for floating licenses |
| `/api/v1/ai/chat` | POST | License Key / Token | Proxy AI chat completion through secure vault |
| `/api/v1/s2s/licenses/issue` | POST | Builder Secret Key | Programmatic license key generation |
| `/api/v1/s2s/licenses/revoke` | POST | Builder Secret Key | Revoke compromised or refunded license |
| `/api/v1/s2s/webhooks` | POST | Builder Secret Key | Register builder webhook endpoints |
| `/.well-known/jwks.json` | GET | Public | Retrieve Ed25519 JWKS for offline verification |
